To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a software tool FINDX that can be applied to the LC-MALDI MS data and which allows to reduce the number MSMS-acquisitions for validation of crosslinks to a minimum.

off-line LC-MalDI-TOF-TOF is an efficient tool to detect crosslinks within and between proteins, which is further optimized by the software FINDX to reduce the MSMS-data to acquire for validation of the crosslinks.
the software FINDX can be used to reduce the MSMS-data to be acquired for validation of lysine-specific crosslinks within and between proteins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a workflow for the detection and validation of protein-protein interactions by chemical crosslinking, LC separation and mass spectrometry.
the development of new strategies to detect protein-protein crosslinks by mass spectrometry, to identify crosslinked peptides and their crosslinks and to validate the crosslinks by MSMS.
the development of new methods to study the molecular architecture of protein oligomers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of chemical crosslinking and mass spectrometry, in particular LC-MALDI MS/MS, is a powerful method for the structural characterization and validation of protein-protein interactions.
the combination of chemical crosslinking and mass spectrometry, with the use of FINDX, is a very promising method for protein structure analysis.
FINDX and the LC-MALDI/TOF/TOFTOF approach is a powerful tool to reduce the amount of MSMS data to be acquired for crosslink identification and validation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FINDX software can be used to reduce the number and the complexity of MSMS-spectrum acquisition for crosslink validation.

we have developed a method for the detection of crosslink sites between proteins, which is based on the detection of the isotope doublets in MS and the use of this information to reduce the number MSMS spectra acquired.

the combination of chemical crosslinking, off-line LC-Maldi-TOF/ TOF, FINDX software, and MSMS-acquisition focusing on crosslinks is an efficient and powerful strategy to characterize protein-protein interactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of FINDX and LC-MALDI is a cost-effective and efficient strategy for the identification of protein-protein crosslinks.
MS-data can be used as a powerful filter to focus MSMS-acquisition for crosslink detection.
by using the FINDX software to sort MSMS-acquisition to the most promising peptides, MSMS can be focused on crosslinks and thus reduce the amount of time and effort required for data interpretation.
